Lower Endoscopy Report
Date of service: 2026-10-28
Endoscopist: Synthetic Endoscopist, MD (fictional)
Sedation: propofol by a CRNA (fictional)
Procedure: Colonoscopy
The colonoscope was advanced to the cecum and the appendiceal orifice was photographed.
A 6 mm sessile polyp in the descending colon was removed with a hot snare.
The snare-resected descending colon polyp was not retrieved; it was lost in the lumen.
Impression: one descending colon polyp removed.
